response.sql: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS order_avg_fill FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.timespan), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, order_avg_fill, AVG(order_avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS timespan_avg_fill, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY order_avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank FROM order_averages) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, order_avg_fill, order_avg_fill - timespan_avg_fill AS above_timespan_avg, fill_rank FROM ranked WHERE order_avg_fill > timespan_avg_fill AND fill_rank <= 3;
